content.short: Hex Trust is a regulated institutional custodian offering custody, staking and markets services.
content.description: Hex Trust is a fully regulated provider of institutional custody, staking and markets services to builders, investors and other service providers. Its Convert to Pay API lets regulated payment providers accept digital assets and settle in fiat compliantly. A separate wealth platform, Aura, offers relationship-led digital asset management on the same institutional infrastructure. Alongside custody and staking, the firm produces market commentary for clients.
content.meta: Licensed custody, staking and markets services for institutions across several jurisdictions.
